# SDLC Architecture

Use `solution-architect` and `architecture-design`.

Provide:

```text
Application: <name>
Application Root: <application-root>
```

Read:

`<application-root>/docs/sdlc/requirements.md`

Entry gate:

`Requirements Status: APPROVED`

Write:

`<application-root>/docs/sdlc/architecture.md`

Do not re-derive product requirements from Jira/Confluence/Word during normal Architecture.

If requirements are missing or ambiguous, return to Requirements Analysis.
